technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish momentum (Ichimoku TK cross, MACD 8/21 crossover) offset by overbought conditions and weak intermediate/long-term trend structure; moderate confluence but elevated risk from momentum extremes.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 17 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 2 small purchases by non-senior members) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (352.48), flat yield curve, and earnings in 17 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ACN trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term Ichimoku TK cross and MACD 8/21 crossover provide fresh bullish momentum with price near support (284.04), and extreme fear sentiment creates contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Crisis-level VIX, earnings risk in 17 days, price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, overbought oscillators, weak intermediate/long-term trend structure, and zero fundamental/smart-money support create compounding headwinds that outweigh short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term Ichimoku TK cross and MACD 8/21 crossover provide fresh momentum at support, and extreme fear sentiment creates contrarian opportunity.
